title_en: Catalogue of Judicial Interpretations Issued by the Supreme People's Court before the End of 2000 to be Abolished (Sixth Batch)

articles.content_en:
List of Relevant Judicial Interpretations (Sixth Batch)
(Adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court at its 1214th meeting on February 22, 2002; the abolished judicial interpretations shall cease to be applicable as of May 29, 2002.)
